@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Dora is studying for an exam tomorrow, so her family is keeping quiet so as not to d______t her.
= distract
~詞義 distract（v.）使分心
~原文 Dora is studying for an exam tomorrow, so her family is keeping quiet so as not to distract her.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The scientist is an a______e of renewable energy and frequently speaks at public events to promote its benefits.
= advocate
~詞義 advocate（n.）倡導者
~原文 The scientist is an advocate of renewable energy and frequently speaks at public events to promote its benefits.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jason has disappeared; no one knows his w______s.
= whereabouts
~詞義 whereabouts（n.）行蹤
~原文 Jason has disappeared; no one knows his whereabouts.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I believe that everyone should be treated equally, r______s of their race, gender, or religion.
= regardless
~詞義 regardless（adv.）不論
~原文 I believe that everyone should be treated equally, regardless of their race, gender, or religion.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Taiwan's real estate business b______med during the second half of the 1980s, when the economy was prosperous.
= boomed
~詞義 boom（v.）迅速發展
~原文 Taiwan's real estate business boomed during the second half of the 1980s, when the economy was prosperous.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The rejection letter ______ Eason's dream of studying abroad, so he felt disappointed but determined to try again.
A: pleaded
B: conceived
C: disconnected
D: shattered
= D
~詞義 shatter（v.）終結;嚴重破壞
~原文 The rejection letter shattered Eason's dream of studying abroad, so he felt disappointed but determined to try again.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Mindy said that the cake I had made was the best cake she had ever eaten, but I think that was a(n) ______.
A: domain
B: exaggeration
C: pedestrian
D: sensitivity
= B
~詞義 exaggeration（n.）誇大
~原文 Mindy said that the cake I had made was the best cake she had ever eaten, but I think that was a(n) exaggeration.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Let me set a ______ on my smartphone, or else I might forget about our appointment.
A: competence
B: pillar
C: reminder
D: therapy
= C
~詞義 reminder（n.）提醒
~原文 Let me set a reminder on my smartphone, or else I might forget about our appointment.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The audience watched the violin performance in ______. The musician played fantastically.
A: awe
B: fluid
C: pier
D: theft
= A
~詞義 awe（n.）驚歎
~原文 The audience watched the violin performance in awe. The musician played fantastically.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mayor's dedication to maintaining the wellbeing of his citizens is ______ of our respect.
A: bound
B: nasty
C: grim
D: worthy
= D
~詞義 worthy（adj.）值得的
~原文 The mayor's dedication to maintaining the wellbeing of his citizens is worthy of our respect.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: boost
B: aisle
C: competent
D: estate
E: habitat
F: odds

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tina is a(n) ______ worker. Her supervisor has no problem with letting her take charge of cases independently.
= C
~詞義 competent（adj.）有能力的
~原文 Tina is a(n) competent worker. Her supervisor has no problem with letting her take charge of cases independently.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The wild parrot's natural ______ is the rainforest.
= E
~詞義 habitat（n.）棲息地
~原文 The wild parrot's natural habitat is the rainforest.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Against all ______, the group won the competition despite its limited resources.
= F
~詞義 odds（n.）儘管困難重重(against all odds)
~原文 Against all odds, the group won the competition despite its limited resources.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The author went on a tour to ______ the sales of her latest novel.
= A
~詞義 boost（v.）提高
~原文 The author went on a tour to boost the sales of her latest novel.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: "The product that you are looking for is in ______ eight," the supermarket clerk said.
= B
~詞義 aisle（n.）走道
~原文 "The product that you are looking for is in aisle eight," the supermarket clerk said.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: sequence
B: compliments
C: pleaded
D: therapist
E: impulse
F: vending

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before heading to class, Julie bought a bottle of water from the ______ machine.
= F
~詞義 vending（adj.）販賣機(vending machine)
~原文 Before heading to class, Julie bought a bottle of water from the vending machine.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man admitted to his crime and ______ with the judge for a lighter sentence.
= C
~詞義 plead（v.）懇求
~原文 The man admitted to his crime and pleaded with the judge for a lighter sentence.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sam ______ his wife on her cooking and good looks every day. That is his secret to maintaining a happy marriage.
= B
~詞義 compliment（v.）讚美
~原文 Sam compliments his wife on her cooking and good looks every day. That is his secret to maintaining a happy marriage.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My physical ______ said that I must fix my posture if I want to get rid of my backache for good.
= D
~詞義 therapist（n.）治療師
~原文 My physical therapist said that I must fix my posture if I want to get rid of my backache for good.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: When Mandy saw the clear running water in the stream, she had a sudden ______ to dip her feet into it.
= E
~詞義 impulse（n.）衝動
~原文 When Mandy saw the clear running water in the stream, she had a sudden impulse to dip her feet into it.
